about: The habit ideas and plans as phones show them, after the admin's edits in wording/live (`ideas`, `plans`). Run by scripts/admin_lookup/test/ideas.test.js (wording/ideas_rules.js resolveIdeas, resolvePlans) and by the app (habit_ideas.dart resolveIdeas, resolvePlans), so the Habit ideas page shows before Publish what phones show after it. `cases`: `builtIn` is the ideas list as in assets/data/habit_ideas.json, `edits` the stored `ideas` field. `expect.ids` is the whole list in order, `expect.featured` the featured ids in that order, `expect.names` the Arabic name of each id it lists. `expect.fields`, when present, gives resolved fields in HabitIdea.toJson form: null means the idea has no such field (timesPerDay null is once a day). `planCases`: the same for the plans; `builtIn` is the plans in habit_plans.dart order, `edits` the stored `plans` field, and there is no featured list. Rules the cases hold both sides to beyond the spec's words: in `text`, null takes away an optional field (sourceAr, sourceEn, reminder, limit, timesPerDay) and any other value of the wrong type is ignored; fields are applied in one fixed order whatever order the document lists them in (often before timesPerDay), then timesPerDay is dropped unless the idea is a daily habit to build and limit unless it is a habit to quit; category is one of the spec's nine; added ideas without an order follow the built-ins sorted by id; `hidden` never takes off an added idea.
